description: This file contains implementations of pointwise tensor operations for the Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the PyTorch library, focusing on addition, multiplication, division, and their combinations, with internal caching and stream management.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for MPS computational graphs to optimize repeated tensor operations related to division and multiplication.

methods.name: addc_mul_div_out_mps
methods.description: Core function that performs combined addition, multiplication, or division on tensors using MPS, with caching and graph optimization.
